mapper.select: SELECT id, symbol, market_code, max_position_per_user, max_position_total, maintenance_margin_rate, max_leverage, hedge_threshold_usd, direction_imbalance_ratio_threshold, direction_imbalance_min_total_usd, pending_order_min_distance_ratio, created_at, updated_at FROM t_risk_config WHERE symbol = #{symbol}

SELECT id, symbol, market_code, max_position_per_user, max_position_total, maintenance_margin_rate, max_leverage, hedge_threshold_usd, direction_imbalance_ratio_threshold, direction_imbalance_min_total_usd, pending_order_min_distance_ratio, created_at, updated_at FROM t_risk_config WHERE symbol IS NULL LIMIT 1

ORDER BY symbol ASC, id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_risk_config ( id, symbol, market_code, max_position_per_user, max_position_total, maintenance_margin_rate, max_leverage, hedge_threshold_usd, direction_imbalance_ratio_threshold, direction_imbalance_min_total_usd, pending_order_min_distance_ratio, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{symbol}, #{marketCode}, #{maxPositionPerUser}, #{maxPositionTotal}, #{maintenanceMarginRate}, #{maxLeverage}, #{hedgeThresholdUsd}, #{directionImbalanceRatioThreshold}, #{directionImbalanceMinTotalUsd}, #{pendingOrderMinDistanceRatio}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt} )
mapper.update: UPDATE t_risk_config SET max_position_per_user = #{maxPositionPerUser}, max_position_total = #{maxPositionTotal}, max_leverage = #{maxLeverage}, hedge_threshold_usd = #{hedgeThresholdUsd}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE symbol = #{symbol}
